integrity: Infinite theorem derived by explicit cyclotomic-order valuation and subset-degree induction; finite checks supplement but cannot replace proof. Prime-density corollary invokes the known PNT for arithmetic progressions.
scientific_limitations: Only prime-power indices and prime fields; exact modular conditions do not classify indices with multiple distinct prime factors. Literature non-coverage is not an independently certified novelty claim.
title: Prime-power divisor-degree completeness: an exact congruence trichotomy
